title: The Glory of `Eid al-Adha
body:
RabbunAllah HasbunAllah 8x
HasbunAllahu n`ima 'l-wakeel ni`mal Mawla wa ni`ma 'n-naseer wa ilayka 'l-maseer.
As-salaamu `alaykum. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, Sayyidina
Muhammadin wa aalihi wa sahbihi ajma`een.
O our Attenders! May Allah forgive us, for the honor of His most honored one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!
And we are asking this on this most holy day, `Eid ul-Adha, `Eid ul-Hajjaaj, which is one of the biggest and
most honored days in the whole year. And we are saying now, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah,
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! Come to Islam! O People! Come and say (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Laa ilaaha illa-Llah Sayyidina
Muhammadan Rasoolullah (s). (Mawlana Shaykh sits) That will save all Mankind, to say Kaleematu 'shShahadat (Mawlana Shaykh stands), laa ilaaha illa-Llah Sayyidina Muhammadun Rasoolullah (s)! (Mawlana
Shaykh sits)

O People! Enough of being drunk. People are drinking drinks and becoming drunk, but generally, all people
now are drunk for dunya. Everyone is running after dunya, thinking they are going to live forever, up to
Eternity. For dunya there is a time that the Lord of Heavens is giving and the days of dunya are in limits;
days, weeks, months, years, centuries. When reaching its limit, finished! And also everyone's lives are in
limits. When you are reaching that limit, it can't be even one second more nor a second less; you must be
taken away.
O People! Wake up! In east and west, from north to south, you have been honored to be deputies of the Lord
of Heavens! Think on that honor that no other creature is granted, only Mankind! Keep it and be thankful,
and try to be an obedient servant for the Lord of Heavens, Who created everything, and created Mankind
also. According to the prophecy knowledge, now we are reaching the last century of life on this planet. Try to
reach for your Lord, Allah Almighty's happiness and pleasure. Try to make your Lord happy with you, and He
will make you happy here and Hereafter.
This is a very holy, important day. Millions of people are running to the Holy Land, saying labbayk Allahuma
labbayk, labbayk Allahuma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, inna 'l-hamda wa ni`mata laka wa 'lmulk laa shareeka lak.
O Mankind! In east and west, Christians and Jewish people! For fifteen centuries people were running to visit
the Holy Land, the House of the Lord, and the most beloved and honored servant's holy tomb also. How was
then the seal of the Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) able to reach
millions of people's hearts and move them to run after these holy days, to make a visitation to the House of
Lord and his most beloved servant's tomb in the Holy Land? No-mind people are saying Islam is not a real
religion. If its not real, it will have no power. How can an orphaned person's order (of Prophet) continue for
fifteen centuries? You are thinking he is an ordinary one. No! You are ordinary ones, but he is extraordinary!
All Creation is created for his honor! If all shaytans and their agents say, raghm `ala anfuhum, in spite of
their will, Islam is still up, never changed, and its command continues! And today perhaps two-billion
Muslims are running today to mosques, to make sajdah to their Lord, Almighty Allah! But yet, those people
are drunk, not accepting the Holy Qur'an or the Holy Prophet! If you accept it or not, what will change? Islam
is up, Islam's command continues!

O People of the Muslim world! You are also very careless ones, asking to be like western people, and you are
not even giving a little care to keep Islam and Islamic orders!
O People! Come and listen! From east to west, from north to south, you must come to Islam or that heavenly
whip will also come on you! If that heavenly whip comes on the non-Muslim world once, it will come on you
ten times more, because you are not taqdeer, appreciating Islam; you are running to be westernized! No! Let
western people reach al-Haqq, and join you in the east. They are asking to come there, and you are asking to
go to sunset side of this world. Why? Western people's hearts are in the Oriental world, but Oriental people
are now drunk because they are asking to reach sunset places. They now have no minds to think on that
point. They lost their mentalities! Islam is on Heavens and everything against Islam is underground. How
can you ask to go down the wells and not come up (to the surface)? May Allah forgive us!
O People! We may speak on it from now up to next year, but you must understand.`Eid Mubarak. Keep Islam
well and Allah will keep you; otherwise, if you are not keeping Islam no one can protect you or save you, not
here or Hereafter.
Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anaa Muhammadun `abduhu wa rasooluh!
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! 7x
